column1: # scripts/mutation/targets.tsv — the TIER-1 mutation watch-list (ADR-049).
# Columns (tab-separated):  relpath <TAB> app <TAB> owning test files (space-separated)
# WHAT EARNS A ROW HERE. Tier 1 is the structural chokepoint/guard set — the
# modules CLAUDE.md calls "governed by construction", the ones whose failure mode
# is a silent policy bypass rather than a visible crash. Every mutant of every row
# must be killed by that row's OWNING tests, or carry a ledger entry. ~60 mutants,
# a few minutes: this is the set ci.sh runs under SAMEN_MUTATION=1.
# WHERE THE OWNING-TEST COLUMN COMES FROM. Wherever a shipped sabotage already
# targets the file, the owning tests are that sabotage's TEST_FILES header — so
# the attribution is not a guess, it is already gate-proven by
# scripts/sabotage.sh. Rows marked (derived) below are exactly those.
# ADDING A ROW. Run `scripts/mutate.sh --file <relpath> --targets <this file>`
# first: a row whose owning suite does not kill its mutants must not be committed
# green — either write the tests or put the survivors in the ledger with a
# justification. A row whose file has ZERO mutation sites is refused by
# scripts/mutation_lint.sh (a target that cannot be mutated certifies nothing).
# NOT tier 1: Ash resource/blueprint DSL files (their `public? true` /
# `allow_nil? false` options mutate into hundreds of low-signal sites) and the
# 155-file sabotage corpus at large — reach those with `--corpus`, which derives
# its target set from the sabotage headers and is a soak, not a gate step.
# --- files chokepoint (ADR-014/ADR-024; the only storage_key minting path) -----
samen_core/lib/samen/files/chokepoint_guard.ex
# --- PII write path (the vault write guard + the change that routes plaintext) --
samen_core/lib/samen/pii/write_guard.ex
samen_core/lib/samen/vault/change.ex
samen_core/lib/samen/pii/classification.ex
# --- delivery chokepoint (derived: sabotage TEST_FILES) ------------------------
samen_core/lib/samen/delivery/chokepoint.ex
# --- approvals / reveal gate (derived: sabotage TEST_FILES) --------------------
samen_core/lib/samen/approvals/gate.ex
# --- cross-org FK policy (derived: sabotage TEST_FILES) -----------------------
samen_core/lib/samen/policy/same_org_fk.ex
# --- the masking test-infra itself: if this can be weakened undetected, every
# --- masking proof built on it is suspect (derived: sabotage TEST_FILES) -------
